data_fields.name: zone_music_track
data_fields.donor_constant: biome zon key music, e.g. cubyz:totaldemented/leaves

best_idea: A bed keyed to the current zone whose fade starts from the current gain and slope, so walking back into the previous zone mid-fade reverses smoothly instead of jumping.
decision_why: Keep the zone-keyed bed and the reversal rule; overlap old and new beds for the same 5 s instead of the donor's dip to silence, because a zone border should not go quiet. Sound is client-only and zone music is zone data, so this fits the rulings.
acceptance: Walk from a bog zone into a cold-mountain zone in the browser: the bog track falls while the mountain track rises over the same 5 s with no silent gap; step back into bog at 2.5 s and the bog track continues from its current level with no audible jump.
